notes.title: Gaming Cafe Life is out of early access!
notes.content:
Finally, after months of beta testing and fine-tuning, your dream had officially launched: Gaming Cafe Life was out of Early Access!
But this momentous occasion wasn't just for you.  This was for everyone – the passionate players who helped us refine the experience, the tireless testers who squashed every bug, and every single person who believed in our vision and offered their unwavering support. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you!
Now, it was time. Time to grab a seat, fuel up with some delicious eats, and dive headfirst into an epic gaming experience unlike any other.

[list]
Here's some of the new features featured in our latest content update, 1.7!
[*] New Feature: Drink Machine!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938105/b71f4d6f3cefdd383589f14ba2383adab554f835.png[/img]
[*] New Items!
[*] Bug fixes!
[/list]

============================================

Akhirnya, setelah berbulan-bulan menjalani beta testing dan penyempurnaan: Warnet Life 2 sudah resmi keluar dari Early Access!
Namun momen penting ini bukan hanya untuk Anda. Momen ini dirayakan untuk semua orang – para pemain bersemangat yang membantu kami menyempurnakan pengalaman bermain, para tester yang tak kenal lelah untuk  membasmi semua bug, dan setiap orang yang percaya pada visi kami dan memberikan dukungan tak tergoyahkan. Dari lubuk hati kami yang terdalam, terima kasih!
Sekarang, waktunya telah tiba. Saatnya untuk mengambil tempat duduk, mengisi perut dengan makanan lezat, dan terjun langsung ke pengalaman bermain game epik yang tak tertandingi.

[list]
Berikut adalah fitur terbaru di Update Versi 1.7!
[*]Fitur Baru: Mesin Minuman!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938105/b71f4d6f3cefdd383589f14ba2383adab554f835.png[/img]
[*]Barang baru!
[*]Fix bug!
[/list]
